notes:
# OverCue 0.9.5

For CDJ-3000 firmware 3.22, supporting the guarded RK3399 and R8A7796
hardware profiles.

- Adds beat-grid BPM editing: halve or double the grid BPM, or turn on Change BPM
  and use the rotary selector in 0.1 BPM steps. Turn editing off to save.
- Saves BPM edits on local USB and media hosted by other linked players running
  this update, and refreshes library and Now Playing BPM while preserving phrase
  and vocal indicators.
- Adds independent Phrase and Vocal display switches in Shortcuts.
- Adds optional Smart Cue in Shortcuts: triggering or recording a Hot Cue or loop
  also sets the main cue point, independently of Gate Cue.
- Tapping the Now Playing artwork hides or restores the track title and artwork.
  Hidden artwork shows the default icon on the main screen and a black center
  on the jog display, with cue and position markers retained.
- Linked stem waveforms now reflect partial volume levels when both players
  run this update.
- Stem volume dragging adjusts from the current level without jumping to the
  initial touch position. Level indicators also refresh while playback is paused.
- Improves stem volume response with Master Tempo enabled.
- Repositions Gate Cue and its touch target.
- Fixes saving playlist reorders for playlists inside folders.
- Clears stale phrase and vocal indicators after unloading or ejecting local
  or linked media.

Existing prepared stem media remains compatible.
